enable_distributed_training: enable distributed training mode with NCCL backend for multi-GPU or multi-node PyTorch jobs
gather_tensor_across_ranks: gather tensors from all ranks to the main process or all-gather to every rank
check_is_main_process: check if the current process is the main process with global rank zero
save_in_main_process: save a PyTorch model or tensor to disk only from the main process
synchronize_all_processes: synchronize all processes with a distributed barrier when using multi-process training
